//: Template for MUNI backend services. Copy to <service>/tsconfig.json as-is.
//module: NodeNext matches the ESM services ('type': 'module' in package.json) and requires .js extensions on relative imports, which is the convention across backend/services.
//include: Only the service's own sources. Files imported from ../../shared are still type-checked transitively via the import graph — do not add shared/**/* here or the service will compile unrelated modules.
//rootDir: Deliberately unset. Services import from ../../shared and ../../infrastructure, which sit outside the service directory; any rootDir inside the service makes those imports fail with TS6059.
